item.title: About
item.description: This Body of Work is Dedicated to: Samantha Ames You embarrass me. You embarrass yourself. Embark on a journey, both harrowing and enlightening. This space is my sanctum, where truth spoken is sacred, where I expose scars left by a partner whose relentless campaign of invalidation warped my sense of self and nearly consumed me. It’s a haven for piecing back together a shattered self-image, for separating fact from folklore, for dissecting layers of half-truths, and for discerning genuine promises from misdirection, omissions, and hollow words.
